Montréal Communique 


24 February 1971 
For release at will 


60-HOUR HOCKEYTHON 
FOR YMCA FUND DRIVE 


Bolstered by four all-girl teams, young people from 
Verdun and LaSalle intend to play more than 23 days of 
non-stop hockey to raise funds for the YMCA. 

Youthful organizers of the gruelling marathon are 
targeting to top the 60-hour record they set last year. 

Opening face-off will be on Friday February 26th, 
4.00 p.m., at Crawford Park's Queen Elizabeth RInk. 
Entrance is near Penniston Ave, and Crawford Bridge. 

Local residents are sponsoring relays of participants 
at varying amounts per hour for time spent on the ice. 

Proceeds will be turned over to the YMCA, which 
urgently requires $400,000 to carry on its diversified 
range of services and programs in Greater Montreal.
